label: Mathematics for Data Science & AI
blurb: Zero-to-expert math for data and AI: algebra, functions, linear algebra, calculus, backpropagation, optimization, information theory.
title: Mathematics for Data Science and AI: From Zero to Expert
subtitle: A hands-on mini-textbook that starts from school arithmetic and ends at SVD, backpropagation, Adam and KL divergence, with many worked examples and runnable Python for every idea.
tagline: Taught the IIT Professor Way — Real Numbers. Real Problems. Real Understanding.
appendix_sub: Every key formula and identity from Chapters 1 to 17, grouped by chapter. Use it for revision, not for first learning.

chapters.title: Numbers, Algebra and Equations
chapters.sub: Fractions, percentages, powers, algebra and solving equations: the grammar of every formula you will meet.

chapters.title: Functions, Graphs and Modelling
chapters.sub: A function is a machine. Lines, curves, composition, inverses and how to read a graph like a professional.

chapters.title: Exponents, Logarithms and Growth
chapters.sub: Why e matters, why logs turn multiplication into addition, and where sigmoid, softmax and log-loss come from.

chapters.title: Sums, Sequences, Sets and Counting
chapters.sub: Sigma notation, series, logic, proof by induction, permutations and combinations.

chapters.title: Vectors and Geometry
chapters.sub: Vectors as data, arrows and directions: dot product, norms, angles, projections and cosine similarity.

chapters.title: Matrices and Linear Transformations
chapters.sub: Matrix multiplication, inverse, determinant and rank, seen both as arithmetic and as geometry.

chapters.title: Linear Systems and Vector Spaces
chapters.sub: Gaussian elimination, column space, null space, LU decomposition and when a solution exists.

chapters.title: Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors and Special Matrices
chapters.sub: The directions a matrix does not turn: diagonalization, the spectral theorem, PageRank and Markov chains.

chapters.title: SVD, PCA and Matrix Decompositions
chapters.sub: Singular values, low-rank approximation, PCA from scratch, QR, Cholesky and recommender systems.

chapters.title: Limits and Derivatives
chapters.sub: Rates of change from first principles, the differentiation rules and numerical derivatives.

chapters.title: Using Derivatives, Integrals and Taylor Series
chapters.sub: Finding maxima, measuring curvature, area under a curve, probability densities and local approximations.

chapters.title: Multivariable Calculus and Matrix Calculus
chapters.sub: Partial derivatives, gradient, Jacobian, Hessian, matrix derivatives and Lagrange multipliers.

chapters.title: The Chain Rule and Backpropagation
chapters.sub: Computational graphs, automatic differentiation and a neural network trained entirely by hand.

chapters.title: Optimization: From Gradient Descent to Adam
chapters.sub: Convexity, gradient descent, momentum, Adam, Newton's method, KKT conditions and linear programming.

chapters.title: Probability Mathematics and Information Theory
chapters.sub: Expectation algebra, multivariate normal, entropy, cross-entropy, KL divergence, mutual information and Markov chains.

chapters.title: Math Interview Bank, Pitfalls and a Study Plan
chapters.sub: The questions interviewers really ask, the mistakes everyone makes and a 12-week plan.

chapters.title: Project Lab: Five Math-from-Scratch Projects
chapters.sub: PCA, linear regression, a neural network, PageRank and image compression, built with nothing but NumPy.
